content: In English sentences where the direction of style transfer was found to be correct (Figure FIGREF32 ), changes in use of contractions were reported in 19 cases (e.g. I have just been vs. I've just been), lexical changes in 15 cases (e.g. 'cause vs. because, or sure vs. certainly), grammatical in 13 (e.g. replacing no one's gonna with no one will, or method of production with production method), missing or added words or phrases in 8 cases.
